scripts.db:migrate:remote: pnpm --filter @aiusage/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

DB.description: D1 stores device enrollment and usage breakdowns. Remote migrations run during deployment.

SITE_ID.description: Stable deployment identifier, e.g. `site_a1b2c3d4`. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 8` and prefix `site_`.

ENROLL_TOKEN.description: Shared secret used by `aiusage enroll` to register devices. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

DEVICE_TOKEN_SECRET.description: HMAC key for device tokens. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

PROJECT_NAME_SALT.description: Salt for masked public project names. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 16`.
